FX-FASTLEG-001.says: Blurriness 10: Fast Box Blur at radius 3.7 and 3 iterations, reaching 12 pixels; column 15, twelve right of the square, is lit and column 16 is clear.

FX-FASTLEG-002.says: Blurriness 5: radius 1.85, the box of 3 pixels and 0.85 of the next on each side, laid on three times, reaching 6 pixels.

FX-FASTLEG-003.says: FX-FASTLEG-001 with Repeat Edge Pixels: the square's orange is read past the left edge, and the layer does not grow.

FX-FASTLEG-004.says: FX-FASTLEG-001 with Blur Dimensions horizontal: spread across only.

FX-FASTLEG-005.says: FX-FASTLEG-001 with Blur Dimensions vertical: spread down only.

FX-FASTLEG-007.says: Blurriness keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 20 at frame 4, linear: frame 2 is Blurriness 10, FX-FASTLEG-001's picture.

FX-FASTLEG-008.says: A Float composition: Blurriness 5, then Exposure +6. The light falls away to nothing 6 pixels right of the square and no further.

FX-FASTLEG-009.says: Blurriness -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-FASTLEG-010.says: Blurriness 1001, above 1000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-FASTLEG-011.says: Blur Dimensions "Both": the word is exact, so a capital is not it. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-FASTLEG-012.says: Repeat Edge Pixels "on": the word is "transparent" or "repeat". The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-FASTLEG-013.says: Blurriness keyed to 1200 at frame 4. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
